name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: 0.0.218: The Android TV app now plays a friend's or linked server's title as stored, fetched straight from that server, instead of always going through a conversion on this server. When a title's usual sound track does not play on the device (TrueHD or DTS in a browser, for example) and it has another track in the same language that does, that track is now offered first; a track you pick yourself is still used. The Android phone app still plays through this server, and a friend's separate subtitle file can still fail when that friend is not converting the title.
